ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB$ is the diameter of the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$, and $\angle A=25^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB$ is the diameter of the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$, \\
then $\angle ACB = 90^\circ$, \\
thus $\angle A + \angle B = 90^\circ$, \\
moreover, since $\angle A = 25^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle B = 90^\circ - \angle A = 90^\circ - 25^\circ = \boxed{65^\circ}$.
